status_meanings.open: Required exit criteria remain unmet; existing partial implementation may exist.
status_meanings.in_progress: An assigned implementation slice is active; the full gate remains unmet.
status_meanings.complete: All exit criteria have reviewed evidence tied to the release candidate; no gates currently have this status.

evidence_policy: evidence_paths are navigation to existing source and tests, not assertions that tests passed at reviewed_commit. Each completion requires commit-pinned validation and remaining-assumption review.

gates.title: Supported semantics and release contract
gates.exit_criteria: Freeze input/source profile, trap and hypothesis semantics, outcome vocabulary, resource policy, runtime dependencies and target list; link positive and negative conformance cases.
gates.current_assessment: Planning contract added; source fragment is implemented but no versioned conformance profile is qualified.

gates.title: Checked serialized input
gates.exit_criteria: Validate framing, dimensions, indices, operand references, graph order, widths and spans before consumers; malformed/truncated/adversarial inputs must fail closed.
gates.current_assessment: BDD/CNF input shape guards implemented with 179 truncation cases plus reference and width checks. Variable maps, outer framing and live storage validation remain unchecked parts of the admission boundary.

implementation_slice.qualification: Focused implementation and regression evidence; not a completed release gate or a claim of green hosted CI.

gates.title: Allocation and ownership failures
gates.exit_criteria: Every allocation failure schedule must return a non-authoritative failure, avoid null ownership/dereference, release each successful allocation once, and clear stale verdicts.
gates.current_assessment: Shell/certificate null-allocation guards and cleanup implemented; 28 failure masks pass focused tests. Upstream allocations and formal lifecycle composition remain open.

implementation_slice.qualification: Focused implementation and regression evidence; not a completed release gate or a claim of green hosted CI.

gates.title: Source-to-term refinement
gates.exit_criteria: Compose checked source semantics with generated terms, including path hypotheses, traps, widths, signedness, aggregates, calls and loop limits for the frozen profile.
gates.current_assessment: Differential corpora exist; whole source-to-term semantic refinement remains open.

gates.title: Global CNF state invariants
gates.exit_criteria: Establish initialization, freshness, memo/unique reuse, bounded probing and refusal invariants for the actual mutable state and all node constructors.
gates.current_assessment: Bounded CNF probing and invalid-entry guards implemented with a 264-case corpus and 16 audited proof closures, including extracted-loop termination. The global mutable-state invariant remains open.

implementation_slice.qualification: Focused implementation and regression evidence; not a completed release gate or a claim of green hosted CI.

gates.title: Whole term-to-CNF composition
gates.exit_criteria: Prove actual term traversal and root obligations preserve satisfiability and justified constant outcomes, including hypotheses, traps and resource refusal.
gates.current_assessment: Local gates, folds, obligations, layouts and buffer readback are proved; whole traversal composition remains open.

gates.title: Authority of every verdict path
gates.exit_criteria: Account for constants, exhaustive evaluation, witnesses, BDDs and CNF certificates; only checked sound evidence may settle a row, and contradictory evidence must leave it open.
gates.current_assessment: Go cross-check response admission now requires complete, unique rows before evidence is accepted. This covers -cross go; -cross none and whole verdict-path semantic composition remain open.

implementation_slice.qualification: Focused implementation and regression evidence; not a completed release gate or a claim of green hosted CI.

gates.title: Source counterexample reconstruction
gates.exit_criteria: Every reported refutation reconstructs typed source parameters and replays the original claim or a trap under its hypotheses; abstract-operation assignments alone cannot refute it.
gates.current_assessment: CNF models are checked; end-to-end source reconstruction and abstract-operation replay require qualification.

gates.title: Runtime failures and resource limits
gates.exit_criteria: Exercise budget exhaustion, timeout, cancellation, worker death, short or failed I/O and stale output; all outcomes are bounded, correctly classified and preserve evidence rules.
gates.current_assessment: Budgets and cancellation exist; systematic failure matrix remains open.

gates.title: Self-hosted admission boundary
gates.exit_criteria: Either qualify a Go-independent checked-source admission path or explicitly ship a checked-input engine with a versioned producer contract; never label Go frontend validation as fully self-hosted source admission.
gates.current_assessment: Self mode has no Go proof decisions with cross none, but Go syntax/type/borrow/discipline validation is mandatory.

gates.title: Checker executable refinement
gates.exit_criteria: Connect complete checker entry, control flow, loops, memory accesses, allocations and FFI assumptions to the actual artifact for each claimed target.
gates.current_assessment: Selected native bodies, guards, calls and loads are covered; the complete executable chain is open.

gates.title: Whole solver target qualification
gates.exit_criteria: Run required whole-solver acceptance on ARM64, RV64 and Wasm artifacts; fail on missing runners, skipped required cases or unintended C fallback; record target/toolchain identity.
gates.current_assessment: Existing native shell test is ARM64-host restricted; compiler fixtures are not whole-solver qualification.

gates.title: Reproducible bootstrap and artifacts
gates.exit_criteria: Pin source, compiler, proof dependencies, flags, target and artifact hashes; reproduce from a clean checkout and reject corrupt/stale cache entries.
gates.current_assessment: Solver cache uses content digests and atomic publication. Separate generic buildcache size/mtime identity and unchecked binaries, nonhermetic headers/libraries, release bootstrap and artifact manifests remain open.

implementation_slice.qualification: Focused implementation and regression evidence; not a completed release gate or a claim of green hosted CI.

gates.title: Performance and search quality
gates.exit_criteria: Define representative deterministic workloads, per-target memory/time budgets and regression thresholds; publish decided/open coverage and distributions at the release SHA.
gates.current_assessment: Existing measurements are useful host baselines, not qualified native release budgets.

gates.title: Acceptance composition and release ledger
gates.exit_criteria: Attach reviewed evidence and successful required runs to one release commit and artifact set; all mandatory gates close with declared assumptions and no unexplained skips.
gates.current_assessment: This ledger records requirements and gaps; it is not evidence of a release passing them.

snapshot_note: reviewed_commit anchors the original inventory. First-wave slice updates describe local integration after that commit; they do not attest a final integrated SHA, hosted CI result or release qualification.
